Priya Singh: Hi team — need a compact launch package for next week's webinar: 1-pager (security + SLA highlights), short benchmark blurbs, a speaker script, and precise inbound routing rules for HubSpot. Can we assemble and review by tomorrow? :calendar:

Priya Singh: Core ask: make the one-pager "runbook-first" 1: single-page checklist for SEs + AE handoff, with exact tag names for routing.

Omar Khan: Suggest we lead with regulatory angle (audit logs, KMS/HSM integrations) then slide into SLA guarantees and fallback modes. Ops care about exact failover timelines.

Jules Park: Slide idea: visual 4-step failover + canary flow. Keep it icon-driven. Also short script for opening 30s:
```
Hi, Im Jules from Redwood. Today well show how customers keep inference within SLOs during bursty traffic while meeting security controls. Well cover a real benchmark, deployment modes, and the exact runbook SEs use.
```

Leo Rivera: HubSpot routing rules (exact tag names below). Use these verbatim when creating form logic and workflows: private-hot, compliance-review, low-latency, benchmark-interest. Pseudo-rule:
```
if (deployment == "private" && compliance == "yes") { assign = "AE-Enterprise"; tag = "private-hot" }
else if (p99_target <= 150) { assign = "SDR-Platform"; tag = "low-latency" }
else { assign = "Inbound-Field"; tag = "benchmark-interest" }
```

Priya Singh: perfect Leo. Add recommended first-touch email for private-hot: subject "Private deploy checklist" with link to runbook. Make the email copy 1-2 lines.

Leo Rivera: Nurture snippet (first touch):
"Thanks for registering. Quick checklist to prep a private run: infra size, compliance framework, p99 target. Download runbook: [link]"

Omar Khan: Benchmarks - propose 3 bullets for the one-pager: median p50 latency (hosted vs dedicated), p99 under 95th percentile bursts, and token cost comparison (hosted vs quantized dedicated). Keep numbers rounded.

Jules Park: Messaging tweak: replace "models are expensive to serve" with "models are predictable to serve with the right runtime and routing". More positive.

Maya Patel: I'll fold all copy into a tight one-pager. For webinar CTA use "Request runbook" + form fields: company name, infra estimate, compliance yes/no, p99 target. Capture those exact field names in HubSpot.

Leo Rivera: Will create HubSpot form with fields: Company, InfraEstimate, ComplianceYesNo, P99Target. Will add tags from earlier and route to AE-Enterprise for private-hot.

Omar Khan: Add slide for canary metrics to help SEs: what to monitor (latency, CPU, GPU util, cache hit-rate). 3 bullet checklist.

Priya Singh: Social promo draft: "Webinar: Runbooks for predictable, compliant LLM inference — real benchmarks & field-ready playbooks. Register: [link]" Keep it short and add one benchmark tease.

Jules Park: Benchmark tease suggestion: "See our customer cut p99 spikes by 3x using Dedicated + caching" (one line).

OpsBot: Event placeholder created: "Runbook Webinar  Predictable & Compliant Inference" on 2026-05-01 17:00 UTC. Speakers: Jules Park, Omar Khan. Recording placeholder: https://meet.redwood.example/evt/xxxx

Priya Singh: timeline: finalize assets today, review tomorrow AM. If anyone needs edits DM me. Thanks! :rocket:
